# DELETE /api/v1/orgs/{org}/actions/runners/{runner_id}

Delete an org-level runner

**Module:** [routers](../modules/routers.md) · **Auth:** bearer · **ID:** `ep-050`

## Request

| Param | Location | Type | Required |
|-------|----------|------|----------|
| org | path | string | True |
| runner_id | path | integer | True |

**Headers:** `Authorization`

## Response

**204** — empty

- **400** — invalid request
- **404** — runner not found or not editable in org context

## Workflow

| Step | Module | Component | Type | Details |
|------|--------|-----------|------|---------|
| 1 | [routers](../modules/routers.md) | Action.DeleteRunner | controller | extract org ID and runner_id from context |

| 3 | [routers](../modules/routers.md) | shared.getRunnerByID | service | get runner from DB by ID; check EditableInContext(ownerID, repoID) |
| 4 | [models](../modules/models.md) | actions_model.DeleteRunner | repository | verify runner exists (redundant SELECT); delete by ID |

## Business Rules

| Rule | Category | Condition |
|------|----------|-----------|
| Runner must be editable in the org context - runner.OwnerID must match the org's ID | authorization | ownerID > 0 && r.OwnerID == ownerID |

## Error Handling

| Trigger | Status | Response | Retryable |
|---------|--------|----------|-----------|
| runner ID not found in DB | 404 | Runner not found | False |
| runner not editable in org context | 404 | No permission to access this runner | False |

### Error Paths

- **runner not found by ID** → shared.getRunnerByID → 404
- **runner not editable in org context** → shared.getRunnerByID → 404
